description: Start a video clip from a prompt, optionally from a start image (image to video), a start and end frame (mode frames), or reference images that keep a character consistent (mode reference). Charged to the user's Leaxor credits when it starts — the price depends on model and length, so check list_models first and tell the user the cost. Clips take one to five minutes: this returns an id, then call get_clip until it's done. A failed clip is refunded automatically.

aspect.description: e.g. "9:16", "16:9" or "1:1". Must be one the model offers.

audio.description: Native sound, on models that support it. Usually costs more.

duration.description: Seconds, e.g. "5". Must be one the model offers (list_models).

end_image.description: frames mode: https URL of the closing frame.

model.description: Model id from list_models. Defaults to the mode's default model.

reference_images.description: reference mode: https URLs of the characters or objects to keep consistent.

resolution.description: Optional, e.g. 720p or 1080p, on models that offer it.

start_image.description: https URL of the opening frame. In generate mode this makes it image to video.

name: generate_clip
title: Generate a video clip
